text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Tch. I keep sayin' this injury's no big
deal, but
they won't stop tellin' me to
rest.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Is my engine goin' rusty? Am I gettin'
weaker?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Is my engine goin' rusty? Am I gettin'
weaker?
choice_data_list: なら、エンジンふかそうか？

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, but I've got a rival to beat.
There's no rest
when I'm tryin' to get to
the top.
choice_data_list: なら、エンジンふかそうか？

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: No little injury like this is gonna stop me.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Urgh...
choice_data_list: 壊れたバイクじゃ走れない

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...I guess it'd be even lamer if I stalled
out in the
middle of the road.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'll get back out there after some
maintenance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After reflecting on her condition, Vodka
agrees
to focus on resting in order to
speed up her
recovery.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
All right! Time to go vroom 'round the
track!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I can't let Scarlet see me lookin' this
pathetic.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Might be askin' the impossible, but when
push
comes to shove, I gotta do what I
gotta do!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vodka says this and resumes her
training, but...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Ngh! Owww!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I thought I could handle it, but even just a light jog is rough.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Go ahead and laugh. I was all confident
earlier,
but now look.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having pushed herself past her limits,
and
perhaps also due to the mental
slump
accompanying it, Vodka has
wound up
prolonging her recovery time.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Really?! Are you sure?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: All right, then! Say no more!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Time for one more sprint, partner!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
These engines are one of a kind! Rev 'em
up and
they spit fire!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Just you watch. Everyone else'll be
cowed by my
might and I won't give 'em
a single inch!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It'll be me and me only! Pedal to the
metal and
leadin' the pack!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Admirably, Vodka gets through her
training!
